<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFBBCD"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="4"/>
      <feOffset dy="4"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope=".25"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="900" fill="#000000">9:41</text>

  <line x1="324" y1="22" x2="324" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <circle cx="42" cy="102" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="126" r="4" fill="#F38093" opacity=".7"/>

  <text x="195" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="19px" font-weight="300" fill="#000000">Tap the globe to enter</text>

  <!-- Globe shadow and animated rings -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="359" r="137" fill="#000000" opacity=".10" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="359" r="126" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity=".7"/>

  <circle cx="228" cy="414" r="5" fill="#FFD663"/>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="121" y="518" width="148" height="52" rx="31" fill="#F88D9C" opacity=".8"/>

  <circle cx="195" cy="599" r="4" fill="#F38093"/>
  <circle cx="180" cy="599" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="599" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  </g>
  <g>

  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="340" cy="778" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="778" x2="340" y2="772" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="778" x2="345" y2="781" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="340" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Map</text>
  </g>
</svg>
